results.title: Rashid Seidu writes: Madina at the crossroads – Why Siidi must go unopposed
results.content: Madina is tired of waiting. Tired of promises that fade after the votes are counted, and of roads, jobs and hope that never arrive. Now, as 2028 draws near, the constituency has one question to answer: who will finally deliver? I have spent time listening to the people. I have sat with elders, youth, traders, students and party faithful across Madina. Whatever the neighbourhood, the answer is the same: *Siidi Abubakar Musah. According to the significant number of people I have engaged so far, they are all calling for him. They describe him as a good man with a good heart, whose hand has touched many lives, both nationally and here at home in Madina. results.content: In a significant boost to Ghana's industrialisation drive and agricultural value addition, President John Dramani Mahama has commissioned a state-of-the-art 100-metric-tonne-per-day cashew processing factory in Techiman, Bono East Region.

results.title: AngloGold Ashanti Obuasi wins SSI Foundation Company of the Year
results.content: AngloGold Ashanti Obuasi Mine has received multiple honours at the 10th edition of the Sustainability and Social Investment (SSI) Awards, including the SSI Foundation Company of the Year award. The Mine also secured several corporate awards, while its Managing Director, Dr Ing. Sam Pobee, and Director of Sustainability Management, Edmund Oduro Agyei, received individual recognitions. Dr Pobee was named SSI Impact CEO of the Year for his leadership and commitment to responsible mining, sustainability and socio-economic development. Mr Oduro Agyei received the Sustainability Professional of the Year award for his work in advancing the Mine’s sustainability agenda through community development, strategic partnerships, economic empowerment and social investment.
